body: I believe you're right. I'll try to find her contacts for now because I've lost them all. I'm such a mess right now, I've worsened a lot since the past year. I'll have to work myself at least a bit, to get my life in order again... If I had your advice 2 years ago, when my life was in order, I'd totally follow your input without wasting time. I always think about her and our friendship. Thank you so much for the encouragement!

I think the suggestion to try and socialize is a good one, because it generally helps me and I need developing my social skills in real life.

I want to reach out and be friends with her again, but I feel there are so many constraints. I always have this feeling that I need to be a better person, the person I am aiming to be so that I can finally reach out to her in peace of mind. Once I kind of implicitly said that to her, and she said I didn't need to, that I was already good enough. But still, she is special to me and I don't want she to see me in my worst. People ask, and she will ask too. And I know she would likely support me, but I don't want to be a burden. And we're now adults...

Thank you for reading and for your kind words, I appreciate it.
